benchmark_construction.source_distinction: While inspired by stage-1 corpus observations on ungranted request payload toggling (doc-51fcf1f7d11b99fb, where toggling only wasted dynamic power), read-return stall handshakes (doc-1e32ca3765d0cb27), and AXI domain ordering/timing (doc-f7cb249afaf70ebf), the four concrete obligations in this task—S1/S2 kill recovery in cva6_icache.sv, AXI4 AR payload stability under backpressure in cva6_icache_axi_wrapper.sv, burst write AW/W handshake in axi_shim.sv, and technology-independent RTL area/timing closure (<= 8,200.0 um^2 at 2.10 ns in Nangate45)—are defined by the CVA6 subsystem and AXI4 contract.
